rule_title: S3 bucket has no public access block with all four settings true
checkov_titles: Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block

rule_title: S3 bucket ACL is public-read or public-read-write
checkov_titles: S3 Bucket has an ACL defined which allows public READ access.; S3 Bucket has an ACL defined which allows public WRITE access.

rule_title: S3 bucket has no explicit server-side encryption configuration
checkov_titles: Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket is securely encrypted at rest

rule_title: Security group allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 on port 22
checkov_titles: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 22

rule_title: Security group allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 on port 3389
checkov_titles: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 3389
Ensure all data stored in RDS is not publicly accessible

rule_title: RDS instance has storage_encrypted false or missing
checkov_titles: Ensure all data stored in the RDS is securely encrypted at rest

rule_title: EBS volume has encrypted false or missing
checkov_titles: Ensure all data stored in the EBS is securely encrypted

rule_title: CloudTrail trail is not multi-region or log file validation is off
checkov_titles: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all Regions; Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled

rule_title: IAM policy document allows Action: "*" on Resource: "*"
checkov_titles: Ensure IAM policies that allow full "*-*" administrative privileges are not created

rule_title: KMS key has enable_key_rotation false or missing
checkov_titles: Ensure rotation for customer created CMKs is enabled

rule_title: Hard-coded secret-like literals in provider or resource arguments
checkov_titles: Ensure no hard coded AWS access key and secret key exists in provider
